rahu.name: Rahu
rahu.shortDesc: North Node of the Moon — the point where the Moon's orbit intersects the ecliptic
rahu.fullDesc: Rahu in Digital astrology is the North Node of the Moon, the point where the Moon crosses the ecliptic (the apparent path of the Sun) from south to north. It is not a physical body but a mathematical point possessing immense power.
rahu.westernEquivalent: North Node of the Moon / Dragon's Head (Caput Draconis)

ketu.name: Ketu
ketu.shortDesc: South Node of the Moon — the point opposite to Rahu
ketu.fullDesc: Ketu in Digital astrology is the South Node of the Moon, the point opposite to Rahu. It symbolizes past experience, spirituality, and letting go. Helps release old patterns.
ketu.westernEquivalent: South Node of the Moon / Dragon's Tail (Cauda Draconis)
ketu.example2: Helps let go of the past

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.shortDesc: Planet of discipline, karma, and long-term results
saturn.fullDesc: Saturn is the slowest planet in astrology, symbolizing time, discipline, responsibility, and karmic lessons. Rewards hard work and punishes laziness.
saturn.westernEquivalent: Saturn — planet of structure and limitations

mars.name: Mars
mars.shortDesc: Planet of action, energy, and aggression
mars.fullDesc: Mars is the planet of action, energy, initiative, and aggression. Governs physical strength, courage, and the ability to defend one's interests. In Digital astrology — Mangala.
mars.westernEquivalent: Mars — planet of war and passion

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.shortDesc: Planet of communication, intellect, and commerce
mercury.fullDesc: Mercury is the planet of thinking, communication, learning, and trade. Governs intellect, speech, writing, and all forms of communication. In Digital astrology — Budha.
mercury.westernEquivalent: Mercury — planet of mind and connection

venus.name: Venus
venus.shortDesc: Planet of love, beauty, and harmony
venus.fullDesc: Venus is the planet of love, relationships, beauty, art, and comfort. Governs aesthetics, pleasures, and material goods. In Digital astrology — Shukra.
venus.westernEquivalent: Venus — planet of love and beauty

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.shortDesc: Planet of wisdom, expansion, and luck
jupiter.fullDesc: Jupiter is the most favorable planet, symbolizing wisdom, knowledge, spirituality, prosperity, and expansion. Governs teachers, philosophy, and religion. In Digital astrology — Guru.
jupiter.westernEquivalent: Jupiter — planet of luck and abundance

sun.name: Sun
sun.shortDesc: Symbol of soul, ego, and life force
sun.fullDesc: The Sun is the central luminary, symbolizing the soul, ego, self-expression, and life force. Governs leadership, authority, and self-esteem. In Digital astrology — Surya.
sun.westernEquivalent: Sun — symbol of personality and will

moon.name: Moon
moon.shortDesc: Symbol of mind, emotions, and subconscious
moon.fullDesc: The Moon is the symbol of mind, emotions, intuition, and subconscious. Governs mood, memory, motherhood, and public opinion. In Digital astrology — Chandra.
moon.westernEquivalent: Moon — symbol of emotions and instincts

1.name: 太阳
1.title: 新人生策略
1.description: Time for brightness and self-expression. Start new projects.
1.shortDesc: 勇气和果断行动的时刻
1.fullDesc: 太阳的能量带来清晰、领导力和新的开始。这是您采取大胆步骤并启动重要项目的时机。
1.advice: 开始新事业，要求晋升，成为焦点

2.name: 月亮
2.title: 关系与外交
2.description: Time for intuition and diplomacy. Build relationships.
2.shortDesc: 充满直觉的平静、内省时期
2.fullDesc: 月亮的能量带来情感敏感性和接受性。不推荐开始新事业。专注于关系和外交。
2.advice: 建立关系，参观剧院和博物馆，拓展视野

3.name: 木星
3.title: 系统与成功
3.description: Time for growth and expansion. Learn and travel.
3.shortDesc: 启动新项目的绝佳时期
3.fullDesc: 木星的扩展智慧带来成长和机会。分析、结构和签署合同的完美时机。
3.advice: 启动新项目，签署合同，分析提案，获取知识

4.name: 罗喉
4.title: 野心与物质化
4.description: Time of surprises and changes. Be flexible.
4.shortDesc: 专注于目标、健康和内在工作
4.fullDesc: 罗喉（北交点）的能量放大欲望和物质追求。适合设定雄心勃勃的目标，但要注意沉迷。西方等价物：北交点/龙头
4.advice: 走向新事物，想出创意解决方案，设定雄心勃勃的目标

5.name: 水星
5.title: 规模与沟通
5.description: Time for communication and learning. Negotiate.
5.fullDesc: 水星支持沟通和社交。在此期间，许多项目将产生稳定的结果。
5.advice: 进行谈判，扩大项目规模，结识新朋友，积极沟通

6.name: 金星
6.title: 爱与舒适
6.description: Time for love and beauty. Enjoy life.
6.shortDesc: 享受生活并完成旧任务的时刻
6.fullDesc: 金星带来和谐与美丽。享受生活、完成旧任务、进行优质购买和投资的时刻。
6.advice: 享受生活，完成旧任务，进行优质购买，投资

7.name: 计都
7.title: 转变与灵性
7.description: Time for spirituality and self-discovery. Meditate.
7.fullDesc: 计都（南交点）通过放手带来灵性洞见。冥想、治疗和释放旧模式的时刻。西方等价物：南交点/龙尾
7.advice: 修行灵性，分析自己的行为，独处，冥想

8.name: 土星
8.title: 金钱与努力
8.description: Time for discipline and work. Be responsible.
8.shortDesc: 开始新活动的绝佳时期
8.fullDesc: 土星奖励纪律和努力工作。签署合同和做出重要决定的完美时机。只要努力工作，成功就会随之而来！
8.advice: 开始新活动，签署合同，做出重要决定，勤奋工作

9.name: 火星
9.title: 完成与净化
9.description: Time for action and completion. Finish tasks.
9.shortDesc: 总结生活各个领域的时刻
9.fullDesc: 火星带来完成开始事情的能量。高情感强度。总结和净化的时刻。
9.advice: 总结，净化空间，排毒，行善
warnings: 纪律和运动将帮助找到平衡

marsNegotiations.title: How Mars Affects Negotiations
marsNegotiations.scenario: Important business negotiations or signing a contract
marsNegotiations.goodTiming: Mars is favorable for closing deals, not for starting new ones. If your personal day is 9, it's time to wrap up and close current issues.
marsNegotiations.badTiming: Starting new negotiations on day 9 is risky — conflict or aggression may arise from both sides.
marsNegotiations.tip1: On day 9, focus on completion, not beginning
marsNegotiations.tip2: If negotiations drag on — postpone to day 1 (Sun) for a fresh start
marsNegotiations.tip3: On day 9, it's better to sign the final contract than to start discussions
marsNegotiations.tip4: Control your emotions — Mars intensifies irritability

mercuryPresentations.title: Presentations and Public Speaking
mercuryPresentations.scenario: Important project presentation or public speech
mercuryPresentations.goodTiming: Day 5 (Mercury) — perfect time for communication. Your words will find response, arguments will be convincing.
mercuryPresentations.badTiming: Day 7 (Ketu) — energy of isolation and inner work. The speech may not have the expected effect.
mercuryPresentations.tip2: Day 5 is also great for networking
mercuryPresentations.tip3: Prepare in advance — Mercury loves details

jupiterStartup.title: Launching a New Project or Startup
jupiterStartup.scenario: Launching a new business, product, or important project
jupiterStartup.goodTiming: Day 3 (Jupiter) — best day to start. Energy of growth, expansion and wisdom will support your endeavors.
jupiterStartup.badTiming: Day 2 (Moon) — energy of uncertainty and doubts. Decisions may be emotional, not rational.
jupiterStartup.tip1: Jupiter is the planet of luck — use day 3 for important launches
jupiterStartup.tip2: Also good for signing contracts and agreements
jupiterStartup.tip3: Day 3 is favorable for learning and gaining knowledge

venusDate.title: Romantic Date and Relationships
venusDate.scenario: First date, confessing feelings, or important conversation about the future
venusDate.goodTiming: Day 6 (Venus) — perfect time for love and harmony. Energy of beauty and pleasure creates a romantic atmosphere.
venusDate.badTiming: Day 8 (Saturn) — energy of work and discipline. The date may seem too serious or boring.
venusDate.tip2: Day 6 is favorable for expensive purchases and investments
venusDate.tip3: Go on a trip — Venus loves comfort
venusDate.tip4: Avoid empty spending — focus on quality

saturnContract.title: Signing Long-term Contracts
saturnContract.scenario: Signing an important long-term agreement or contract
saturnContract.goodTiming: Day 8 (Saturn) — excellent time for serious commitments. Energy of discipline and structure ensures stability.
saturnContract.badTiming: Day 4 (Rahu) — energy of illusions and temptations. There may be hidden conditions or deception.
saturnContract.tip3: Day 8 is good for starting new activities
saturnContract.tip4: Avoid breaking rules — Saturn is strict

sunLeadership.title: Showing Leadership and Initiative
sunLeadership.scenario: Important team meeting, appointment to a leadership position, or defending an idea
sunLeadership.goodTiming: Day 1 (Sun) — your energy is at its peak. Leadership, confidence and clarity will help achieve the goal.
sunLeadership.badTiming: Day 7 (Ketu) — energy of turning inward. Public manifestation may be ineffective.
sunLeadership.tip1: Day 1 — best time for new beginnings
sunLeadership.tip2: Ask for a promotion or bonus
sunLeadership.tip3: Be in the spotlight — Sun loves it

moonRelationships.title: Building Relationships and Diplomacy

moonRelationships.badTiming: Day 9 (Mars) — energy of aggression and conflict. The conversation may turn into an argument.
moonRelationships.tip1: Day 2 — time for diplomacy and compromise
moonRelationships.tip2: Visit theaters and museums — Moon loves art

rahuInnovation.title: Innovations and Creative Solutions
rahuInnovation.scenario: Developing a new concept, creative brainstorming, or getting out of crisis
rahuInnovation.goodTiming: Day 4 (Rahu) — energy of ambition and transformation. Unconventional ideas and creative solutions come easily.
rahuInnovation.badTiming: Day 8 (Saturn) — energy of conservatism and rules. Innovative ideas may be rejected.
rahuInnovation.tip1: Day 4 — go into the new, try unconventional things
rahuInnovation.tip3: Be careful with finances — Rahu can tempt
